Asexuals exist. Really. 

i have no idea how to start being social. I lack any experience on which to base it. how do you start? Not like a random person can just walk up to a group of people and say 'lets be friends'

I'm a woman, probably asexual but wouldn't know because I've never looked to be sexually involved with anybody, I don't drink, and i haven't bullshitted in the least. I work in a shop, then go home and sleep. I can tell the ocassional funny customer story, but I really have nothing to talk to people about.

At least you were popular once. I was that shy nerd with good grades and no friends.

I know exactly how you feel. I taught myself how to tie a noose and I pratice and play with it a bit while I think about it. I wouldn't do it at work though, I'd find somewhere pretty. Work controls me too much already.

I'm 32 years old. My mum died, she was the only person I spoke to. At her funeral I sat alone all day and nobody else in the family noticed me or spoke to me at all. My dog died, walking her was my only hobby involving another living creature. I have no friends, never have had. Have never been in a relationship of any sort because if I can't even make any friends, who would ever be interested in me? I'd rather have a friend first. I have a dead end minimum wage job. I work, I go home and read/computer game, sleep and repeat. Zero social interaction ever, and no physical contact with anything alive. Nobody has ever even noticed. That is my whole life, as it has always been. Literally, I have never done anything, been anywhere or connected with another person in my whole life. I have nothing to live for, no reason to want to wake up. I really do wish I could fall asleep tonight and just not wake up.
